description: Defines classes and data structures for handling Clear Key Entitlement Control Messages (ECM), including Ecm, EcmDescriptor, and EcmContainer, used in DRM systems for managing encrypted content keys and related metadata.

classes.name: Ecm
classes.description: Represents a clear Entitlement Control Message (ECM) containing asset ID, system ID, and content key, with methods for parsing and decrypting ECM data.

classes.name: EcmDescriptor
classes.description: Encapsulates an ECM along with an identifier, typically used for crypto period identification in DRM streams.

classes.name: EcmContainer
classes.description: Contains 1 or 2 EcmDescriptors and a count, representing a collection of ECMs transmitted in DRM streams.

methods.name: Ecm::Parse
methods.description: Parses serialized ECM data from a buffer and populates the Ecm object.

methods.name: Ecm::Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an ECM serialized buffer using provided asset information, extracting the content key.

methods.name: EcmDescriptor::Parse
methods.description: Parses a serialized EcmDescriptor and its contained Ecm from a buffer.

methods.name: EcmContainer::Add
methods.description: Adds an EcmDescriptor to the container, replacing the oldest if full.

methods.name: EcmContainer::Parse
methods.description: Parses a serialized EcmContainer and its EcmDescriptors from a buffer.
